note: v1, written: STREETLIGHTS OFF, the closer. Euphoric liquid D&B at 172 bpm in Db major (the style board's t10 row): the album ends at dawn. THE CHANGES Dbmaj9 | Ab/C | Bbm9 | Gbmaj9 on a recorded-grand piano comping 2-step and synth strings; a wordless sung HOOK (the voice engine, vowels turning). A clean liquid kick and snare (driven, squeezed) over a light amen roll, a sub ducked by the kick, the reese only from the second drop. A half-time INTERLUDE with the hook in thirds; THE LIFT: the last drop a semitone up (D), the piano rolling in 16ths, the ride, a one-bar pull-out before it. THE DISSOLVE: the drums leave, then the bass; the piano picks the hook out alone, the voice hums, the city's air comes up. Form: intro 16, build 8, A 32, interlude 16, B 32, lift 16, dissolve 24 - 3:26.
